rules.title: Relocation Payments for Owner/Relative Move-in, Demolition, Capital Improvements, or Substantial Rehabilitation
rules.requirement: Landlords evicting tenants for owner or relative move-in, demolition or permanent removal of the unit from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation must pay relocation amounts per tenant and per unit, plus additional amounts for elderly, disabled, or minor child tenants.

coverage.summary: Covers evictions based on owner/relative move-in, demolition, permanent removal from housing use, temporary capital improvements, or substantial rehabilitation under the San Francisco Rent Ordinance.

rules.quoted_span: Relocation Payments for Evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in OR Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use OR Temporary Capital Improvement Work* OR Substantial Rehabilitation

rules.title: Relocation Payments for Ellis Act Evictions
rules.requirement: Landlords evicting tenants under the Ellis Act must pay relocation amounts per tenant and a maximum per unit, plus an additional amount for each elderly or disabled tenant.

coverage.summary: Covers tenants evicted under the Ellis Act.

rules.quoted_span: Relocation payments for tenants evicted under the Ellis Act
